interpretation_limits: No external Doppler truth is available. The independent 1.333 ms frame-CFO robust line is a common internal reference, not satellite truth.
V2 and V3 measurements are each compared to the robust line fitted to their own acquired frame lattice; this avoids declaring either epoch branch to be truth.
GLRT20ms points are 20 ms estimates emitted every 25 ms by the persisted Standard analysis.
